rules.text: Villas and VD units detached. DP and DT semi-attached. TH attached both sides, always in pairs
Only the 11 Phase 1 clusters are allowed
A block has at most 4 units. A 6-unit block takes an expansion joint at the 4th unit
One FFL per cluster. A split is after unit 2 or 3, with a construction joint and a double wall
Front yard has one slope, parallel to the road, 0.5% to 2%
Back yard graded to the front at 0.3% to 0.5%
rules.pastJob: Differs, yards modelled flat 0.100 under the floor top (Q015)

rules.text: Townhouse back yard at 2% to a soakaway trench along the back boundary
At most 3 added steps. Step heights 100, 200, 270, 370, 440, 540 mm
Riser at least 100 mm, at most 180 mm
C10, VL4 and VL6 always have 1 step
Boundary wall top at FFL + 1.70 m, kept level while FFL steps stay under 0.50 m
Garden wall top at FFL + 1.70 m
Irregular plots: boundary wall 200 mm inside the plot limit, garden wall extends 2.0 m
Foundation at least 1.20 m below existing ground
